routes.name: R_FINITE_ONLY
routes.reason: Finite consistency checks do not prove an ordered thermodynamic limit.

C9000225.statement: Adversarially audit, verify, or refute OpenAI Manuscript Family 225 (Gaussian free field limits throughout the balanced six-vertex regime.; papers: The Gaussian free field limit of the balanced six-vertex model with variance multiplier 1/arcsin(c/2); Lean status: UNFORMALIZED (No Lean proof in openai/math)): either (a) discover and certify an explicit mathematical flaw, sign/orientation error, counterexample to an intermediate lemma, or statement-fidelity/citation gap with a deterministic symbolic/computational certificate (`verify.py` + `exact_certificate.json`), or (b) independently verify, repair, or generalize the manuscript's core mathematical theorem with a standalone machine-checkable certificate certified by the independent Reviewer.

C_MAIN.statement: The staged thm:main asserts the balanced-plane GFF limit for every 0<c<=2, with squared multiplier 1/arcsin(c/2). Not certified by this mission.

C_GFF_REMAINDER.statement: All other load-bearing obligations of the full GFF theorem, including physical-plane identification, angular normalization comparisons, Gaussian currents, probabilistic endgame, and endpoint c=2, remain outside this mission and unverified.

C_NEGATIVE_FIDELITY.statement: For every fixed pi/2<lambda<pi the same real-array half-filled twist fidelity has ordered density 1/(2lambda(pi-lambda)); this extension is proposed for independent review, with no novelty verdict yet.

C_FIDELITY.statement: For every fixed 2pi/3<lambda<pi, lim_{d->0} limsup_{B->infinity} |I_L/B-1/(2lambda(pi-lambda))|=0 for the prescribed real array and half filling.

C_SCALAR.statement: The displayed monodromy, Hilbert adjoint, twisted scalar-product identity, and Cauchy factorization give eq:overlap-determinant-finite.

C_ROOT_CONTROL.statement: The prescribed half-filled array has regular real roots, controlled end cells, uniformly bounded exponentially weighted Gaudin inverses, and arbitrary fixed-order interior counting quadrature accuracy.

C_OVERLAP_JETS.statement: Both overlap orientations admit the stated analytic diagonal coalescence and exact first and second jets; the shifted pair-product quadratic coefficient is sum_{i,j} v_i v_j (log sinh(x_i-x_j+i lambda))''.

C_TRACE_REMAINDER.statement: After finite differentiation, normalized quadratic traces and pair sums differ from the uniform full-lattice calculation by a quantity tending to zero in the specified ordered limit, including all sparse-end and inverse-comparison errors.

C_FOURIER.statement: For both frequency signs, the sampled-pole correction gives relative symbol (1+exp(2pi i z) exp(-lambda p))/(1+exp(-lambda p)); the combined quadratic coefficient and shifted pair product give -1/(2lambda(pi-lambda)).

C_ALG_KERNEL.statement: The pole-corrected Fourier-symbol factorization and the cancellation of accelerations in the shifted pair-product quadratic coefficient are exact algebraic identities.
